summary: Tested 5 priority features for Drawlead OS HR Admin page. All features verified working correctly: 1) HR Admin tab active state has white text (!text-white class), 2) Employee Edit Modal opens with 4 tabs and profile photo upload, 3) Calendar Sunday popup with 3 options, 4) Payroll Management shows employee cards with different statuses, 5) Header Task Manager button visible at 768px viewport.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 priority features tested and working. HR Admin tabs use !text-white class for active state. Edit Employee Modal has 4 tabs with data-testid attributes. Calendar Sunday cells have data-testid='sunday-cell-{date}' and popup has 3 option buttons with data-testid. Task Manager button has data-testid='task-manager-btn'.

hr_admin_tab_active_state_white_text.details: Active tab has 'bg-[#6366f1] !text-white font-medium' classes ensuring white text on purple background

employee_edit_modal_opens.details: Edit button (square-pen icon) on employee cards opens Edit Employee Profile modal

employee_edit_modal_4_tabs.details: Modal has 4 tabs: Basic Details, Account Details, Employment, Address & Emergency with data-testid='edit-employee-tab-{id}'

employee_edit_modal_profile_photo.details: Profile photo section with + button for upload found with data-testid='profile-photo-input'

calendar_sunday_popup_opens.details: Clicking Sunday cells (data-testid='sunday-cell-{date}') opens Configure Sunday popup

calendar_sunday_popup_3_options.details: Popup has 3 options: Working Day (data-testid='set-working-day-btn'), Holiday (data-testid='set-holiday-btn'), Team Holiday (data-testid='set-team-holiday-btn')

header_task_manager_button_768px.details: Task Manager button (data-testid='task-manager-btn') visible at 768px viewport, position x=509, width=128, within bounds

payroll_management_employee_cards.details: Payroll tab shows employee cards with different statuses: Generated (green), Operations Review (orange), Not Created (gray)
